visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with two braids, wearing a cream-colored t-shirt decorated with donut motifs and light blue denim shorts, sits on a wooden staircase indoors. She holds a wooden wand with a cat toy attached, waving it rhythmically while looking down with a focused yet happy expression. The setting is a brightly lit home interior with a white wall and a yellow patterned ball in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a wooden floor area next to a light wood bookshelf and a miniature green piano. An orange-and-white tabby cat emerges cautiously from beneath a low wooden storage unit, its ears perked and eyes wide. A pair of brown house slippers lies nearby on the floor. The lighting is soft and natural, suggesting a daytime indoor environment. (3) The girl stands on the wooden floor, dangling the toy string in front of the orange-and-white cat. The cat reacts by rolling onto its back, playfully swatting at the toy with its paws. The girl's bare feet and the legs of an adult in black trousers are visible. The background features a large air purifier and household furniture in a clean, modern style. (4) The girl sits cross-legged on the floor, holding the plush cat toy directly in her hands and laughing with an open-mouth grin. She appears highly engaged and amused by the toy's texture. Later, the cat is shown sitting on a low, round wooden table in front of a window with a view of greenery, looking off-camera with a curious expression. (5) The girl lies flat on her back on the wooden floor while an adult’s hands use a large, cylindrical bolster pillow—blue with colorful cartoon graphics—to roll gently over her torso. The girl is squinting her eyes and laughing heartily. The room is spacious, with a soft play mat and a toy kitchen set visible in the background under bright daylight. (6) The girl flips over onto her stomach and rolls her body across the blue bolster pillow herself, mimicking the previous motion. She smiles broadly at the camera while moving her arms and legs. The adult continues to interact with her, and the environment remains a safe, cluttered-yet-clean domestic playroom. (7) The video transitions to an animated end screen with a solid pink background. A stylized cartoon character of a girl with braids is shown holding a fruit. Below her, the text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" is displayed in a clean, white sans-serif font. The visual style is minimalist and consistent with a social media vlog outro.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic child's voice yells "More!" as a percussive thud of the girl moving on the stairs is heard. A cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic BGM begins, featuring a bright, plucked string melody and a steady 4/4 drum machine beat. The acoustic environment is a clean indoor space with minimal reverb. (2) An adult female voice, speaking with a friendly and narrative prosody, says "Zai di xia... zhuo zi di xia," followed by a soft, irregular rustling sound as the cat moves across the wooden floor. The BGM continues with its light, upbeat texture. The child provides a short, melodic giggle in the background. (3) The adult voice says "O~ ta xiang wan... man yi dian" with a playful, rising intonation. This is accompanied by the sound of rapid, light percussive clicks and scratches as the cat interacts with the toy on the floor. The music maintains a constant volume and happy, major-key tonality. (4) The child’s laughter becomes the dominant vocal signal, characterized by high arousal and positive valence. The adult asks "Zhe me kai xin o?" with a warm, teasing tone. Spectral density increases slightly with the sound of movement and laughter overlapping the continuous BGM. (5) A new rhythmic phase begins with the adult and child chanting "Yi bi ya ya, yi bi yi bi ya" in a synchronized, sing-song manner. The chanting is perfectly timed with the BGM's beat. The child's vocal energy peaks with loud, rhythmic laughter and short, excited squeals. A "rolling" sound of a heavy fabric object on the floor is audible. (6) The chanting continues as the child says "Wo yao chang" with high confidence and dominance. The sound of clothing rustling and soft thuds increases as the girl rolls over the bolster. The adult's voice is supportive, maintaining a moderate conversational loudness. The phase ends with the adult saying "Shua ya le" in a calm, concluding tone. (7) The BGM swells for a moment before a sharp, clean electronic jingle marks the transition to the animated logo. All vocal and environmental sounds cease, leaving a brief moment of studio-clean silence before the track ends.
